- (capability) CAP-1 intent: provide add(a,b) returning a+b for finite numbers
- (capability) CAP-1 success: unit tests verify add returns correct sum for finite numbers
- (capability) CAP-2 intent: provide subtract(a,b) returning a-b for finite numbers
- (capability) CAP-2 success: unit tests verify subtract returns correct difference for finite numbers
- (capability) CAP-3 intent: provide multiply(a,b) returning a*b for finite numbers
- (capability) CAP-3 success: unit tests verify multiply returns correct product for finite numbers
- (capability) CAP-4 intent: provide divide(a,b) returning a/b for finite numbers, throwing RangeError on zero divisor
- (capability) CAP-4 success: unit tests verify divide returns correct quotient for non-zero divisor and throws RangeError when divisor is zero
- (constraint) Must be dependency‑free and implemented as a pure ES module compatible with Node.js LTS
- (nongoal) CLI interface
- (nongoal) User interface (UI)
- (nongoal) Persistence
- (nongoal) Arbitrary precision arithmetic
